03885c07132372835bfc.text: An outline is a tool used in improving and organizing written ideas about a

12ee2df2d1613935fc64.text: topic into a logical order. Writers use outlines when writing their papers to know which topic to cover and in what order.

7bfca38c324194b635d6.text: What are the types of an outline?

efebfbbb3b189166335d.text: The type of outline to be used by the writer depends on the nature of the topic

5865c35513adae4ef094.text: and purpose of the writer. Topics that are information-heavy may require more major topics and subtopics since the writer’s purpose is to be as informative as possible. However, if the writer wants to be persuasive, outline should only accommodate what is important to the audience’s needs.

c84aade54b0200fa4280.text: There are two types of outline: the sentence outline and the topic outline.

f29537f85509479cb4d6.text: It is a type of outline that presents the thesis statement, major

a1837f3ada9a49eeba89.text: topics, subtopics, and supporting details in sentence form. It allows you to include those details in the sentences instead of having to create an outline of many short phrases that goes on page after page. Also, it follows a hierarchical structure composed of sentences and headings around the subject of the speech or essay.

21c5f6d4fdf4b970e8b5.text: What are the contents of an outline?

6a1549512f180a4cc3a9.text: An outline is composed of many parts. These parts work together to present a

98cb6dcab6e3443e647c.text: clear idea of a paragraph or an essay. An outline contains thesis statement, major topics, subtopics, and supporting details. The following are the parts with their corresponding definition:

rows: Contents of an Outline
Definition
Thesis Statement
A thesis statement is a one-sentence statement that expresses the main idea of an essay.
Major topics
Major topics refer to the major phrases/sentences which are formed from the thesis statement.
Subtopics
Subtopics refer to the minor phrases/sentences which are formed from the major topics.
Supporting Details

Supporting details are phrases/sentences which provide additional information to clarify or prove the main idea. These details help you explain further the ideas presented by the major topics and subtopics.

52fbc70336a6f75bc8e5.text: How to Expand the Content of an Outline Using Different Sources?

ce6348d850af5cc3f9c7.text: In expanding the content of an outline, you need to use primary and secondary

d69fc23921adb16b79e8.text: sources. Primary sources are firsthand information taken from original evidences such as reports on discoveries and events and interviews from persons in authority while secondary sources are secondhand information taken from the primary sources.

d7bc9e10fd8b3c3e275f.text: Below are examples of primary and secondary sources which will be used in

7d75c77f32865a68d800.text: expanding the contents of your outline.

b42d53ce5767bcee1dfb.text: Examples of primary sources include:   diaries, letter correspondence,    original documents e.g. birth  certificates, trial records   interviews, speeches, oral  histories   laws, regulations, constitutions   government documents,  statistical data, research reports    journal article reporting new  research or findings   creative art works, literature   opinion pieces  Examples of secondary sources  include:   journal articles that comment  on or analyses research   textbooks   dictionaries and encyclopedias   books that interpret, analyze   political commentary   biographies   dissertations   newspaper editorial/columns   criticism of literature, art works  or music

3469737c169eb82a553d.text: Source: "Primary And Secondary Sources", UNSW Sydney Library, April 23, 2021,

3ee9839b4a67cd74bd6b.text: Directions: Read the statements and questions carefully. Write the letter of the correct answer on a separate sheet of paper.

f533c921d00d393a0f72.text: 1. Which of the following is NOT a benefit of outlining? Outlining would______.

0ae51e5299d0a130fb5f.text: A. summarize your ideas B. organize your ideas C. present information clearly D. help achieve sentence variety

e7f733e4efd312940678.text: 2. Which of the following best explains secondary sources? Secondary sources present the ________________.

2515e08029d761fb5d9f.text: A. commentaries which come from primary sources B. information which come from secondary sources C. information which are derived from primary sources D. analyses of research paper which are taken from various sources

3bf399d0cac1fb1774d4.text: 3. Which of the following statements is TRUE about primary source? Primary source is a _________________.

fe0bf85847413a7b1892.text: A. summary of the essay B. firsthand information C. concluding information D. secondhand information

0979ad2d4b1644fa569f.text: 4. Which of the following statements is TRUE about major topics? Major topics refer to the_______________.

ce1918d992fc463e962b.text: A. major details which are formed from the major subtopics B. phrases/ sentences which are formed from the subtopics C. phrases/sentences which are crafted from the major subtopics D. major phrases/sentences which are organized from the thesis statement

52ca61180fcb181973f3.text: 5. Which of the following statements describes a sentence outline? A sentence outline_____________________________.

d4c9e51a570bb02eba92.text: A. states varied information in sentence form B. presents the primary and secondary sources C. states the main topic and supporting details in sentence form D. presents the thesis statement, major topics, subtopics, and supporting details in sentence form

92b532ce325b4e750b59.text: 6. What is the first step in writing an outline?

b2796fbdf266996847c8.text: A. Make and organize a list of your subtopics. B. Choose your topic and establish your purpose. C. Create and organize a list of your major topics. D. Provide additional information to support your subtopics.

72f8df86dc3e29465dfb.text: 7. Which of the following defines a thesis statement? A thesis statement is a sentence that_____________________________.

ee42daf0fd2a316289b2.text: A. summarizes an essay B. gives a conclusion of an essay C. expresses the main idea of an essay D. states the relevant information of an essay

245571211fe144d76599.text: 8. Which of the following statements does NOT define an outline?

31ef1b86423b58cc598a.text: A. It synthesizes the idea in your essay. B. It provides an over-all picture of your essay. C. It shows a hierarchical order of ideas. D. It is a tool for organizing the write-up.

1df8335f140cef745e8d.text: 9. Daniel is very excited for the upcoming online meeting with his teammates. As a team leader, he wants to prepare an interesting activity that could be done through online platform. Which of the following would he consider as primary source in searching for an interesting online activity?

8f5361eebe20f7a602a1.text: 10. You want to write a feature article that would encourage people to keep the right attitude and stay hopeful amidst Covid-19 crisis. Which of the following could NOT be considered as best secondary source for your article?

0e3460c00042c50cec98.text: 11. Jen is tasked to write an essay about the importance of obeying the government’s rules and regulations of her country. After writing her thesis statement, what should Jen do in order to organize her ideas?

a5c3253c002b7a7b5882.text: A. analyze the given information B. research on the important information C. choose the main topics and supporting details D. outline the major topics, subtopics and supporting details

563a7680005b9bde5d25.text: 12. Hannah is a passionate writer who wants to expand the content of her outline. Which of the following should she consider first?

bfce2bc3a12385ec3134.text: A. thesis statement of the outline B. summary of relevant information C. use of primary and secondary sources D. outline of the major topics and supporting details

fadcfbc16948fa92c6c9.text: 13. Which of the following should NOT be done in making an outline?

5037947673bdb656a500.text: A. Make and organize a list of your subtopics. B. Review and refine the contents of your outline. C. Present the primary and secondary sources randomly. D. Provide additional information to support your subtopics.

395a838d49b7391fd098.text: 14. Which of the following topics is NOT outlined properly?

5f9b281e192986c3f2da.text: A. Concepts of Love B. Characteristics of Infatuation

fc000a91263137b27b04.text: A. Titanic B. The Passion of the Christ

1ebcfbcbb9917828639b.text: A. Spending Quality time B. Offering of Material things

f0d40272f00edad96cba.text: IV. There are different types of love.

9f8f8cd6194fc79aba45.text: A. Loving someone romantically is called Eros. B. Loving people unconditionally is known as Agape.

6198c105ca7934579b8b.text: 15. Teacher Nina has tasked you to create a topic outline on any subject that interests you. Since you are fond of online games, you opted to write about it. Which of the following should NOT be included in your outline?

7726c0615852a47d2de1.text: A. The Right Response of Parents B. The History and Its Developers C. Statistics of Online Game Users D. Advantages and Disadvantages of Online Games
